title: A finite nonempty cofiltered set diagram has a compatible section
statement: Let $I$ be a small cofiltered category and let $D:I\to\mathbf{Set}$ be a functor, with categories, functors, and cofilteredness as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and size as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Suppose each $D(i)$ is finite and nonempty. Then there is a family $x_i\in D(i)$ such that $D(a)(x_i)=x_j$ for every arrow $a:i\to j$ of $I$. No surjectivity assumption on the transition maps is required.
